entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 as well as
learned Aga for the State and perused the record.

2. The present bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in case crime No. 599 of
2023, under Sections-498A, 304B Ipc and Section-3/4 of D. P. Act, police station Kurawali, District
Mainpuri, with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.

entities.text:
D. P. Act, police station Kurawali, District
Mainpuri
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3.  It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is husband of the deceased and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
The marriage of deceased with applicant has taken place on 18.04.2022.
Only general allegations of dowry demand and harassment of deceased have been levelled against all the accused persons.
It was stated that the deceased was not happy with her marriage with the applicant and she was under depression and committed suicide.

Gaurav vs State Of U.P. on 6 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/33105475/
1
In the post mortem report, except ligature mark, no other injury has been shown on the body of the deceased and cause of death is asphyxia due to ante mortem hanging.
Lastly, it was submitted that the applicant is in jail since 21.08.2023, having no criminal history, and trial of the case would take sufficient long time.
It was submitted that in case the applicant is enlarged on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.

4. Learned A.G.A. as well as learned counsel for informant have opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the applicant is husband of the deceased and she has suffered unnatural death within seven years of her marriage and there are allegations that she was being harassed by the applicant and her family members on account of dowry.

5. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

6. Let the applicant Gaurav involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i. The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii.
The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
7. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant, in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 6.11.2024 RKM  Gaurav vs State Of U.P. on 6 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/33105475/
